items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Betty, you know, I met everybody.

ctx.x: Everybody. It was a must. John would have them as guests and then they would come and sit in. Dave Matthews, when he was with Harry James. Harry James himself. So, I met everybody. Betty, you know, I met everybody.
Yeah. And this went on for how long, I mean, you were with Talbot until the end of '38, or in '38, Teddy Wilson was in '39.
